decision: Selected owner-managed named Raxio Angola data-centre marker; Google Maps geographic coordinates, not a surveyed boundary.
precision_scope: Google owner-managed 'RAXIO ANGOLA (RAXIO DATA CENTRE)' marker on EN 100 in Cacuaco, Luanda Province. It locates the AO1 campus; it is not a surveyed footprint, the 18,903 m2 plot boundary, an entrance or a data-hall location.
horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: The map feature does not publish a surveyed horizontal accuracy.
feature_address: 69MV+PR RAXIO ANGOLA (RAXIO DATA CENTRE), Luanda, Angola
identity_bridge: Raxio's July 22, 2026 release identifies its operating Luanda facility as hosting customers and AFR-IX deployment.

Raxio's October 2, 2025 opening release locates Raxio Angola in Cacuaco, Luanda Province, on a 19,000 square-metre campus; its ESIA non-technical summary gives Estrada do Cacuaco Km 14, Bairro Panguila, a 1.90 ha plot with 126 m frontage on EN 100, next to the Shoprite supermarket.
The selected Google feature is named 'RAXIO ANGOLA (RAXIO DATA CENTRE)' and is managed by its owner under that name. It carries no website link.

excluded_coordinates.reason: Initial Google default viewport encoded in the response URL; unrelated to the selected feature.

PeeringDB facility 16165 coordinates for Edifício Kaluanda office suite (Rua José da Silva, Lameira), which the operator lists as an office address; about 18.9 km from the selected Cacuaco feature. Excluded.

consistency_checks: Projected to WGS84 UTM zone 33S, the selected point has northing 9,030,673 m. The ESIA site plan (Figure 2) grid spans northings 9,030,550 to 9,030,750; its eastings are unlabeled and its datum is unstated, so this is a consistency check only.

A separate query returned the named Shoprite Cacuaco feature on the Estrada Nacional de Cacuaco about 360 m from the selected point, consistent with the ESIA description of the plot beside the Shoprite supermarket on EN 100.

capture_link_chain.response_origin: The search response URL was read from a link in the captured Google Maps HTML; no candidate coordinates were inserted into the query.
capture_link_chain.method: Direct credential-free HTTP captures of public pages (robots.txt allows /maps?q= and /search?*tbm=map).
